newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan MOF to auction 6-year JGBs on Thursday.
newsitem.headline: Japan MOF to auction 6-year JGBs on Thursday.

text.p: The Ministry of Finance (MOF) plans to offer six-year Japanese government bonds (JGBs) through a price-competitive auction on Thursday, a MOF official said on Wednesday.
Traders said the offer volume is likely to be 500 billion yen and the coupon rate is likely to be set at 1.8 or 1.9 percent.
When MOF last auctioned six-year JGBs on March 4, it offered 500 billion yen worth of 1.6 percent six-year bonds. -- Tokyo Treasury Desk +81-33432-8570
